title: Quranic verses calling the world a game

tellings.quote: But in the Islamic traditions, there's actual verses that say, "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport."

plain: Islamic scripture has verses that call this world a game, according to Rizwan Virk, a computer scientist and author who argues we may live inside a simulation. He paraphrases the Quran, the holy book of Islam, as saying "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport," and he offers it in passing, without citing a particular verse, as an old religious hint that the world could be something built, like a game.
